---
title: "The relation typo that does not fail"
---

REQ-A below wanted to say `links-to` (a catalog name) but typed
`linked-to`. Only catalog names parse as relations; anything else is kept
as an ordinary attribute. There is no finding, no error, no warning: the
project scans clean, and the edge the author meant to write simply does
not exist.

This is the trap the gallery exists to teach: run `quarto-needs check` (or
render, and read the card) and look at the object -- the inert attribute is
visible in the inspector, and the missing edge is visible in every view
that would have used it.

::: {.need #REQ-A type="functional-requirement" status="draft" linked-to="REQ-B"}

### Rationale
